protocol: open-close-memory-harness.swift (debug test build). NotchRootView hosted in an offscreen borderless NSWindow that is never ordered in, coordinator.rendersAsActiveDisplay = true. One cycle = toggleExpanded() open, toggleExpanded() close, setHovering(true), setHovering(false); each state laid out and drawn with cacheDisplay. 20 warm-up cycles, then four blocks. Live heap = malloc_zone_statistics(nil).size_in_use after a 300 ms settle.
reading: No per-cycle growth: live heap rises and falls within about 3.7 MB of warm-up and ends 1.5 MB above it after 400 cycles. The state change and layout cost under 0.5 ms per state in debug; the ~105 ms per state is the harness's offscreen software draw, not the app. Not covered: on-screen Core Animation, WindowServer and GPU memory, and animations, which do not run in a window that is never shown.
